Open
How to use
Move a light
Hand: pinch the light (reach out, or look at it and pinch), then drag. Stuck? Tap ▲ ▼ ◀ ▶ beside it.
Controller: point at the light, hold the trigger and drag. Let go to drop it.
Pick a light, switch it on
Hand: look at a light and pinch once. An off fill or rim light comes on.
Controller: point at the light and pull the trigger once.
Brightness and colour
Hand: on the Light page, drag a slider or pinch a spot on it.
Controller: point at a slider, pull the trigger on a spot or hold it and drag.
Shoot, next card
Hand: once the shadow sits in the dashed fence, pinch Shoot, then Next.
Controller: point at the button and pull the trigger.
Material and backdrop
Free light: pinch a ball on the shelf for its material, the upper wall for a new backdrop.
Controller: point at a ball or the wall and pull the trigger.
